name: Sim0 Hazard Labels (CLP) for WooCommerce
author: joesimo

sections.description:
Shops that sell candles, wax melts, essential oils, cleaning products, paints, resins and similar mixtures often have a CLP hazard label on the pack. In the EU, the 2024 revision of the CLP Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2024/2865) adds Article 48a: from 1 January 2028, a distance sales offer such as a product page has to show the label elements of Article 17, including pictograms, signal word, statements, supplier details, nominal quantity and UFI. Sim0 Hazard Labels (CLP) for WooCommerce lets you show the same label elements on the product page, so shoppers can see them before they buy.

Label elements

  • Hazard pictograms GHS01 to GHS09, drawn as plain SVG images
  • Signal word: Danger or Warning
  • Hazard statements (H and EUH codes) and precautionary statements (P codes), picked from built-in lists. The English texts come from Annexes III and IV of the CLP Regulation (consolidated version of 1 July 2026), so you do not have to type them
  • Substances named on the label
  • UFI (unique formula identifier), checked for the XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format
  • Nominal quantity
  • Supplier name, address and phone, with a store default for products that have none of their own
  • Optional link to the safety data sheet

Quick start

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Hazard labels and choose where the label shows. Enter your default supplier.
  2. Edit a product and open the Hazard labels tab in the Product data box.
  3. Tick the pictograms, pick the signal word and search the H, EUH and P statements by code or text.
  4. Update the product. The label shows on the product page.

Where the label shows

  • In its own product tab (you can rename the tab)
  • Below the price
  • Below the add to cart button
  • Anywhere with the [sim0_hazard_label] shortcode, or [sim0_hazard_label id="123"] for a given product

Works with classic themes such as Storefront and with block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Five.

Other details

  • Simple and variable products. For a variable product, the label set on the product covers all of its variations
  • The closing line “Always follow the information on the product label.” can be changed or hidden with the sim0hzl_label_note filter
  • Developer filter sim0hzl_label for the label elements
  • Declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • No tracking, no ads, no external requests
  • Opt-in clean uninstall

Important

This plugin displays the label elements you enter. It does not classify products and it is not legal advice. What you show must match the label on the product. Check your obligations with a qualified advisor.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Sim0 Hazard Labels”, then install and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Hazard labels and check the store settings.
  4. Edit a product, open the Hazard labels tab in the Product data box, enter the label elements and update the product.
sections.faq:
I activated the plugin but my shoppers see nothing. What do I do?

Nothing shows until a hazard label is set up on a product. After activation, a short notice on the Plugins screen links to your newest product: open the Hazard labels tab in the Product data box and pick the pictograms, signal word and statements, then update the product. The notice goes away once that is done, or for good when you dismiss it. The plugin shows no notices on other admin screens. The settings page also says whether anything is showing yet.

Where do I enter the label?

Edit a simple or variable product and open Product data > Hazard labels.

Where are the settings?

WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Hazard labels.

Can I type my own statement text?

No. The statements are shown with the built-in English texts from the regulation, so they always match the code. Optional hints in angle brackets that apply only “if” something is known (for example the route of exposure in H340 or H350) are left out. Statements that have a choice or blank to complete, such as P264 or EUH208, are shown as written in the regulation.

Which languages are the statements in?

English. The rest of the label (headings, pictogram names, signal words) is translation ready.

Can I set a different label for each variation?

Not in this plugin. The label set on a variable product covers all of its variations.

What happens if the UFI or the link is wrong?

The field is not saved, the old value stays, and an error message tells you the expected format.

Does the plugin send any data anywhere?

No. It makes no external requests and does not track anything. All data stays in your WordPress database.

Is data removed when I delete the plugin?

Only if you tick “Remove data on uninstall” in the settings before deleting the plugin. This keeps your labels safe if you delete and reinstall.

What is a UFI?

A UFI is a unique formula identifier, a 16 character code in the format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX that links a product to its formula for poison centres. If your product label has one, enter it in the UFI field and the plugin shows it with the label. The plugin checks the format only.

Do I have to show the CLP label on my product page?

From 1 January 2028, Article 48a of Regulation (EU) 2024/2865 says a distance sales offer for a hazardous substance or mixture, such as a product page, has to show the label elements of Article 17, including pictograms, signal word and statements. Check with a qualified advisor whether your products are in scope. The plugin displays the label elements you enter. It does not classify your product.
